summary: fix(shared): reject failed session token prunes and log them
description:
Because:
- A swallowed prune error kept db.sessionToken.redisPruneFailed from
  ever firing, and a Redis outage would flood Sentry.

This commit:
- Rejects from the WATCH prune on error, as the Lua prune does.
- Logs prune and orphan cleanup failures instead of sending to Sentry.
- Keeps skips, conflicts and no-op prunes resolving without error.

Closes FXA-14945
